## Safety and deployment
- [ ] Production credentials and personal data excluded
- [ ] Money/stock/shipment actions are idempotent and auditable
- [ ] All new/changed negative paths tested
- [ ] Control/security/CI/migration changes require owner review
- [ ] Main merge does not deploy to production
